protocol.title: Fixed-state Memory parameter-group and update-gate causal intervention
protocol.hypothesis: With inherited AdamW state, CPU/CUDA RNG, data stream, and endpoint weights held fixed, freezing the layer-specific Memory pathway or its update gate will selectively alter the route volatility observed in Level 7.5.3.1/7.5.3.2.

parameter_groups.memory_pathway: For layer L, blocks.(L-1).memory.*, blocks.(L-1).memory_read.*, and blocks.(L-1).memory_fusion_gate.*.
parameter_groups.freeze_semantics: Selected parameters retain exact source values and AdamW state but have requires_grad=False for all 1,000 additional C4 steps; all other parameters update normally.

material_effect_definition.formed_vector_changed: Any change in the formed/unformed state at steps300/600/1000 relative to the exact reference.
material_effect_definition.final_fate_changed: Any change in final source-specific L2/L3 route formation.
material_effect_definition.continuous_change: At least 0.15 absolute intact-query difference at one registered post-source milestone.
material_effect_definition.material_effect: Any of the three conditions above.

registered_outcomes.l3_update_gate_dominant: L3 update-gate and full L3 pathway freezes affect the same sources, at least 2/4, while L2 pathway freeze affects 0/4.
registered_outcomes.l3_non_gate_memory_pathway: L3 pathway freeze affects at least 2/4, L3 update-gate freeze affects at most 1/4, and L2 pathway freeze affects 0/4.
registered_outcomes.l2_update_gate_dominant: L2 pathway and L2 update-gate freezes match across all four diagnostic comparisons, with at least one material L2 effect and at most one L3 pathway effect.
registered_outcomes.distributed_l2_l3_memory_pathway: Both L2 and L3 full-pathway freezes affect the diagnostic endpoints.
registered_outcomes.layer_specific_memory_pathway: At least one layer-specific full-pathway effect occurs without satisfying a more specific gate or distributed outcome.
registered_outcomes.no_registered_memory_group_effect: No intervention arm materially changes any registered trajectory.
registered_outcomes.formal_integrity_failed_parameter_interp: A source, fixed-state, frozen-parameter, training, panel, or hash lock fails.

protocol.scope: Mechanism localization on four outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate over the full seed set.
protocol.stop_rule: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, optimizer resets, RNG resets, or post-hoc gates.

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
